name: start_lead_research
description: Start background business prospect research for the current authorized workspace. Use only targeting categories supplied or confirmed by the user. Return the run ID immediately. Never invent a campaign ID.

target_count.description: Desired accepted prospect count; not a guarantee

campaign_id.description: Optional existing workspace campaign UUID, only if supplied

name: get_lead_research_status
description: Read the state, progress, and stopping reason of a background research run.

name: get_lead_research_results
description: Read the first page of researched candidates and evidence. Never claim all results were returned if there is a next cursor.

name: cancel_lead_research
description: Cancel research only when the user requests it. Already accepted campaign deliveries continue. This does not cancel voice outreach.
